_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Pickaxe, which is the only thing that clears a Rockfall (the gated 'smash' tag). ⚑ Q4 (conversation-journal §7 q3, PO 2026-07-30): his `the-lost-lamp` middle leg is GONE — the quest is the simple three-stage version and the game's only non-terminal advance_quest edge went with it (a mechanism should not keep content alive to satisfy a test). The kobold-nest lore he carried stays as an answer-node. R1 shape: greeting at root, the teaching a named row.
name: Miner

lines: The tunnel's overrun and the militia is useless. Mind where you swing.

grants.line: The tunnel is overrun! Take my Pickaxe, I have no use for it anymore.

lines: Kobolds. They nest north of the tunnel and breed faster than I can complain.
Nobody has ever got anything back off a kobold by asking.
